title: Together in Isolation
description: A group of friends watch a movie together in a cell at Penitentiary Unit 47 in Buenos Aires, Argentina, in this image from the 2026 Giga Photo Award competition. The mix-gendered prison holds 10 wards for men and four for women. This photo is part of a series from photographer Magalí Druscovich titled "The weakest link: Women in the drug business," which explores the incarceration of women for drug-related crimes in Latin America. Druscovich attributes the increase in female prisoners over the last two decades to poor circumstances in the region, including violence, lack of education, and poverty. In recent years, the local province allowed inmates the use of cellphones to ease mounting isolation due to COVID-19.
translated_description: 这张来自2026年吉加摄影奖参赛作品的照片中，一群朋友在阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯第47号监狱的一间牢房里一起看电影。这所男女混合监狱设有10个男性监区和4个女性监区。该照片出自摄影师玛加利·德鲁斯科维奇的系列作品《最薄弱的环节：毒品交易中的女性》，该系列探讨了拉丁美洲女性因毒品相关犯罪被监禁的现象。德鲁斯科维奇将过去二十年间女性囚犯数量的增长归因于该地区恶劣的环境，包括暴力、教育匮乏和贫困。近年来，当地省份允许囚犯使用手机，以缓解因新冠疫情导致的日益严重的隔离感。
